description: Defines the 'iron-icon' custom element for displaying icons, supporting icon sets, custom images, and styling options within a Polymer project.

classes.name: iron-icon
classes.description: Custom element class for displaying icons with support for icon sets and custom images.

methods.name: _iconChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the 'icon' property, parsing icon set and icon name.

methods.name: _srcChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the 'src' property, updating the image source.

methods.name: _usesIconset
methods.description: Determines whether to use an icon set or a custom image based on properties.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Updates the icon display based on current properties, applying icon set or image.
